page: Amazon Web Services r8id.12xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud instance built on the AWS Nitro System hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor operating at 3.9 GHz, the instance delivers 48 virtual CPUs across 24 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The CPU subsystem is reinforced by 480 MB of L3 cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and advanced instruction sets including Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions) and AVX-512 for accelerated vectorized computation, encryption, and INT8/BF16 matrix operations.

The hardware configuration features 384.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU ratio. Storage consists of a dedicated 2850 GB local NVMe SSD volume, offering low-latency scratch space and high-throughput disk I/O directly attached to the host. Network throughput is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 22 Gbps. The instance contains no hardware accelerators or GPUs.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate competitive performance across in-memory and data-processing tasks. The platform achieved strong marks in PassMark CPU tests, Geekbench multi-core workloads, and data compression via bzip3 and gzip. In-memory data structures benefit from DDR5 transfer rates, reflected in a Redis SET throughput of 85.77 million operations per second and strong PassMark database scores. Text processing and image processing ranked in the top ten percent of tested servers, while LLM inference benchmarks showed solid throughput for small and mid-sized language models.

The combination of high-density DDR5 memory and direct-attached NVMe storage makes the r8id.12xlarge resource-efficient for I/O-intensive and data-heavy services. Because the instance pairs extensive RAM arrays with fast local solid-state storage, it eliminates the network storage latency penalty for caching tiers. Workloads best aligned with this configuration include in-memory databases such as Redis and Memcached, distributed relational databases, real-time analytics engines, ETL pipelines, and high-concurrency caching layers.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of DDR5 memory, yielding an 8 GB per vCPU allocation, and includes a 2850 GB local NVMe SSD alongside a 22 Gbps baseline network interface.
